{{Quote|Irtanna knows how to take care of herself. She's seen more combat than you and me together.|[[Valenthyne Farfalla]]|<ref name="RoT" />}}
'''Irtanna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who joined the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[1001 BBY]], she was evacuated from [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], along with thousands of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], just before [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Skere Kaan]] detonated the [[thought bomb]] in the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. She was selected personally by [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] to lead the rescue effort on Ruusan, searching for surviving members of the Army of Light.

When Farfalla refused to allow [[Johun Othone]], Lord [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth's]] former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], to join the rescue teams, Othone used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on Irtanna to persuade her to let him join the team, against Farfalla's orders. During the rescue missions, Irtanna piloted the ''[[Star-Wake]]'', an [[Envoy-class shuttle|''Envoy''-class shuttle]], which was also crewed by [[Bordon]] and his sons, [[Tallo (Star-Wake)|Tallo]] and [[Wend]]. Finally, they came across a little girl who seemed to be a war orphan. The girl was named Rain, but was actually revealed to be [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] who served as the student of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. As the ''Star-Wake'' again opened in the direction of the Republica fleet, Irtanna suddenly heard shots from the hold of the shuttle. As she was about to see what was going on, Irtanna found Zannah with a [[Blaster/Legends|Blaster]]; though Irtanna tried to reason with her, Zannah ultimately gunned her down. With the crew [[Death/Legends|dead]], Zannah took the ''Star-Wake'', she set course to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="RoT" />
